CITY OF LA VERNE
  Adjourned Meeting

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Muir Davis, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Robin Carder, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member
  La Verne, CA 91750

  Monday, October 18, 2021, 6:00 p.m.
  La Verne City Hall - Council Chambers,
  3660 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification
or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909)
596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Monday of
every month.

The Council Chambers will be opened to the public. In an effort to keep a safe environment and to minimize
the spread of the COVID-19 Virus, the City will be limiting occupancy to invited guests only and masking will
be required for all in attendance. To facilitate public participation for those who do not wish to attend in
person, the meeting will still be made available virtually to residents. Provisions will be made for public viewing
with a sound system outside of the Council Chambers. Below are the following opportunities on how to
participate:

  1)  View the meeting through the City’s website at www.cityoflaverne.org and click on the green “Council
  Meeting Live Stream” button.

  2)  Individuals can email their comments to the Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org up
  to noon on the day of the meeting. Those comments will be shared with City Council in advance
  of the City Council meeting and included as part of the permanent record. Please be advised
  that public comments submitted by emails or any other format to the City are public
  records that will be made available for public viewing.

  3)  Individuals who wish to share their comments directly during the meeting may do so by emailing the
  Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org with their phone number and the item(s) they wish
  to speak on. Requests will be accepted before and throughout the meeting and staff will call you
  back at the appropriate time. Once items are considered by the City Council, no further public
  comment on that matter will be accepted. A time limit of 3-minutes is set for all public comments.

  4)  If  you  wish  to  participate  via  Zoom,  you  will  need  to  register  at
  https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_6-r0SZBtSiKH5LMUrTwHCg  before 12:00 p.m. on
  Monday, October 18, 2021, and please be aware that space is limited. You will have the ability to watch
  the meeting in real time and raise your hand to request to comment as appropriate on the current
  agenda item(s). Once it is your turn to speak, you will be brought into the meeting and have the ability
  to turn your video on when called upon.
 Agenda, Adjourned Meeting, Monday, October 18, 2021, page 2.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER

  2.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Carder,
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis and Mayor Hepburn.

  3.  Badge Pinning Ceremony for Newly Hired Firefighters/Paramedics, as follows:

  Emmanual Gonzalez grew up in Monrovia California. He graduated from the Yuba Fire Academy in
  2011. Before coming to La Verne, Emmanual worked in construction; he was an Emergency Medical
  Technician and paramedic. He was hired by the La Verne Fire Department in 2020. He enjoys working
  for the City of La Verne and serving its citizens and feels very fortunate to work alongside great
  individuals that have helped him tremendously be where he is in his career. He’s very excited to see
  where the Fire Department is headed and for him to continue to grow as a member of the Fire
  Department. In his pastime, he enjoys the outdoors, camping, snowboarding, spending time with family
  and friends. His badge will be pinned by his mother.

  Michael Jacques grew up in Chino, California. He graduated from Chino High School in 2011. He
  earned his Associate’s Degree in Fire Science from Chaﬀey College in June of 2013, and graduated
  from Mt. SAC’s Fire Academy in 2015. In 2018, he graduated from Mt. SAC’s 85th Paramedic Academy
  and he received his secondary Associate’s Degree in Emergency Medical Services from Mt. SAC in
  2018. Michael worked as a volunteer fire fighter for La Habra Heights Fire Department in 2016 and
  worked as a paramedic for AMR Santa Barbara County for 2 years. Michael loves playing sports and his
  favorite part of sports was working with his teammates, which is one of the many reasons why he
  chose to become a firefighter. His hobbies include: hiking, swimming at the beach, and spending time
  with his dog Koa. His badge will be pinned by his parents.

  Jason Arrow was born and raised in Newport Beach. Jason graduated from Newport Harbor High
  School. After high school he attended San Francisco State University earning a Bachelor’s Degree in
  2002, while being a member, Team Captain, and NCAA qualifier of the Men’s Swim Team. After
  graduating from SFSU Jason returned to Southern California to start his fire career and began working
  for Care Ambulance as an EMT. Jason attended UCLA Daniel Freeman Paramedic School in 2005,
  then working for AMR Rancho as a Paramedic. Jason was hired by Rancho Cucamonga Fire
  Department in 2008 where he was a part of the HAZMAT and USAR teams before leaving for a brief
  stint with the Huntington Beach Fire Department in 2019. In Jason’s free time, he enjoys spending time
  with his family, traveling, at the beach or any outdoor activities. Jason enjoys surfing, scuba diving,
  playing golf, and spending time with friends and family. His badge will be pinned by his son.

  Davis Cook was born and raised in Orange County where he lives with his parents and his brother.
  Davis graduated from Trabuco Hills High School in 2012 and graduated from Yuba College Fire
  Academy in 2013. Davis was inspired to become a firefighter thanks to his father who was a firefighter
  for over 30 years. During his free time, Davis enjoys working out, traveling, and spending time with
  friends and family. His badge will be pinned by his parents.
 Agenda, Adjourned Meeting, Monday, October 18, 2021, page 3

  4.  The La Verne City Council will recess to the La Verne City Council Meeting at 6:30 p.m.

  ADVISORY STAFF

  Robert Russi, City Manager
  JR Ranells, Assistant to the City Manager
  Robert Kress, City Attorney
  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, Assistant City Clerk
  Shawn Igoe, Public Works Director
  Eric Scherer, Community Development Director
  Marla Pendleton, Finance Director
  Nick Paz, Police Chief
  ____Christopher Nigg, Fire Chief
  Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager
  Cody Howing, City Engineer

  Posting Statement: On October 12, 2021, a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on the bulletin board at
  La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at cityoflaverne.org.
